name: koltolabs-site
description: Kolto Labs website: Vite + React + TypeScript, prerendered, served as Cloudflare Workers static assets.

scripts.build: npm run fetch:repos && npm run typecheck && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir .ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/og.mjs
scripts.build:fast: npm run fetch:repos && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir .ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
